title: Keep small fixes on one work item instead of mandatory correction hierarchies
outcome: A bounded change can record and resolve its findings on its existing item; children are used for independently owned or genuinely separate deliverables.
acceptance: A representative fix with a failed check and review correction is traceable through resolution and evidence without extra coordination/acceptance tasks; update standing instructions consistently while preserving unresolved blockers and completion truthfulness.
Replace blanket per-defect child creation with a simple split rule: independent ownership/scope or a real dependency warrants a child; a small in-scope correction can remain on the held item.
